game_title: Guess Until Right – Bone Crypt Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt, a dusty bone crypt: the torchbearer must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Guess Until Right: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bone Crypt: a dusty bone crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Bone Crypt, repeat each round: Keep guessing while guess != secret, narrowing the range using hints. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the guess_range value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about guess_range to power up the torchbearer and open the exit ledge.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Guess Until Right
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Guess Until Right' (Week 4 slot 7), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Bone Crypt'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guess_range changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Bone Crypt.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
